enabled.description:
If `true`, a shareable `url` will be generated that will take your customers to a hosted login page for the customer portal.

If `false`, the previously generated `url`, if any, will be deactivated.

url.description: A shareable URL to the hosted portal login page. Your customers will be able to log in with their [email](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers/object#customer_object-email) and receive a link to their customer portal.
